verdict.line: You lose if you eat Darkness Rise-charged pokes and get grabbed by an unparried Death's Grasp; you win every fight where you parry his E or land vitals before his Siphon of Destruction chips you down.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser has no shield, spell-block, or damage-reduction cooldown to hide behind — once his E (Death's Grasp) is parried he has zero way to close distance on you or stop your combo. But he doesn't need to all-in you either: Q (Obliterate) execute-style damage plus ranged W (Siphon of Destruction) poke and passive sustain from Darkness Rise let him win a lane of pure stat-checks if you never punish a whiffed grab. This matchup is decided by who controls that one interaction, not by raw stats.

theirWindow.when: Passive fully charged, Siphon of Destruction up
theirWindow.what: His next damaging ability or auto deals bonus true damage and heals him — don't absorb it in an extended trade. Back off or bait him into wasting the charge on a minion wave before you commit.

yourWindow.when: He throws Death's Grasp or it's on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Parry a landed Death's Grasp with W (Riposte) to stun him with zero escape, then dump Q (Lunge), E (Bladework), and autos for the full combo. If E is down entirely, he has no way to stop you from initiating first.

powerCurve.note: Obliterate execute damage outpokes your short trades
Riposte threat checks his E, W poke still chips you
Realm of Death forces isolated duels either way
item spikes let full combos outpace his sustain
his poke range and split power outscale your windows

start.why: sustain and early attack damage let you contest trades against his passive heal and Obliterate poke without conceding the wave

boots.why: magic resist blunts Siphon of Destruction and Darkness Rise procs, and tenacity shortens how long you're locked down after a landed Death's Grasp

core.why: the damage, attack speed, and movement burst power your all-in the instant you parry his E or catch him with W down
sustained damage and ability haste shorten your Riposte and Lunge cooldowns for repeated trade windows
converts his ranged poke and passive true damage proc into damage-over-time you heal back or walk off entirely

situational.when: he's poking you down with siphon of destruction before you can close the gap
he's landing realm of death on you every time he hits level 6 and you need insurance for the isolated duel
death's grasp into a jungle gank is chaining enough cc that you can't get a clean parry

runes.keystoneWhy: this lane is a series of grinding stat-checks, not burst trades — Conqueror's ramping adaptive force and sustain win extended fights once you've forced one

summoners.why: Flash punishes or escapes a landed Death's Grasp before he can follow with Obliterate; Teleport resets your item timers and lets you contest his strong wave-clear shove without losing CS

playing.title: Hold Riposte for Death's Grasp
playing.detail: Never burn W on a random auto — his E is the only tool he has to close distance on you, and parrying it stuns him with no follow-up escape.

playing.title: Track his passive charge
playing.detail: Watch Darkness Rise stack up; don't trade into a fully charged proc since it deals bonus true damage and heals him back to full value.

playing.title: Punish Siphon of Destruction cooldown
playing.detail: It's his only ranged answer to your engage. The moment it's down, close with Lunge — he has nothing left to stop the approach.

playing.title: Bank all four vitals before committing
playing.detail: Your R (Grand Challenge) true damage nuke isn't reduced by anything in his kit — pop vitals with Lunge resets before you go for the kill, not mid-fight.

playing.title: Respect Realm of Death from level 6
playing.detail: Don't sit below roughly 60% HP alone once he hits 6 — his ult isolates you for a forced 1v1 with no ally peel available.

playing.title: Break trades before 40% HP
playing.detail: Obliterate deals more damage the lower your health drops, so don't greed one more auto once you're under that threshold.

playing.title: Siege the wave after a parry win
playing.detail: Once you stun him off a parried E, shove the wave into his tower rather than resetting — it denies the CS and sustain his passive needs to stay even.

brief.patchCaveat: Mordekaiser's core kit (Darkness Rise, Obliterate, Siphon of Destruction, Death's Grasp, Realm of Death) hasn't had a full rework in years, but charge counts, damage ratios, and Realm of Death duration shift by patch — verify tooltips in-client. Fiora's item order also rotates between Trinity Force and Stridebreaker-line builds by meta; confirm current standard build on patch 16.18.1 before locking in.
